title: Present Continuous for Future
objectives: Use present continuous for future accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use present continuous for fixed future arrangements.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about present continuous for future. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use present continuous for future?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Am/is/are + -ing for arranged future: I am meeting John at 6.

Often with time expression: tomorrow, on Friday.

grammar.title: Present Continuous for Future
grammar.rule: Am/is/are + -ing for arranged future: I am meeting John at 6.

examples.sentence: I am meeting the team at 3.

vocabulary.example: I am meeting the team at 3.

sentences: I am meeting the team at 3.

reading.title: Present Continuous for Future in Context
reading.text: I am having dinner with clients tomorrow. She is starting her new role on Monday. We are not working next Friday — it is a holiday.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using present continuous for future. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: I am meeting the team at 3. We are flying on Tuesday. It is a firm arrangement. Check your calendar.
